text:
deploy-bot: Staged rollout started by @ashley -> convo-api v5.1.0 at 12% (us-west-2: 6%, eu-west-1: 4%, ap-northeast-1: 2%). Change window: 40m. Release notes: https://go/release/2025-06-12. Watch p99 + 5xx for first 12m. ID: canary-7112223334
ashley: Kicking off watch. Thresholds: p99 +120ms or 5xx >0.7% -> pause. I'll coordinate.
ravi: seeing a small but consistent p99 tail in us-west-2: 320ms -> 610ms over 7m. p95 stable.
kim: looking at traces now, lots of retries to auth-proxy on a shard: `WARN auth-proxy: token validation latency=300ms` and some `401` that later succeed on retry. Could be a partial key rotation hitting canary slice.
eng-release-lead: Is the failure rate limited to the canary cohort or broader?
ravi: isolated to canary us-west hosts. eu-west and ap-northeast are clean. Legacy traffic no change.
ashley: Recommendation: pin us-west-2 back to v5.0.8 and let other regions proceed. That narrows blast radius while we verify auth keys. Thoughts?
oncall-sre: Ops prefer pin. If auth retries keep spiking we risk user visible latency. I'll set page threshold to 1.5% 5xx for 5m.
kim: +1 pin. I'll hunt for any recent KMS rotation events tied to partner slices. Also will capture auth-proxy logs and heapdumps before draining.
ravi: +1 pin. Requesting route pin with graceful drain and collect traces.
ashley: Quick vote: pin us-west or full pause? Reply with +1 pin or +1 pause.
eng-release-lead: I'll cast +1 pin. Keep us-east progressing? We don't have us-east in this rollout. Only us-west, eu-west, ap-northeast.
kim: +1 pin. Found a partial key-roll entry in ops-audit at 2025-06-12T10:14Z affecting partner-slice-12 12. Could explain transient 401s.
deploy-bot: Running command: `route-pin --region us-west-2 --to v5.0.8 --weight 100% --reason "auth-proxy token retries in canary"`
deploy-bot: Route update applied. us-west-2 traffic switched to v5.0.8 (approx 6%). Canary v5.1.0 continues in eu-west-1 & ap-northeast-1 (6% combined). Rollout ID: canary-7112223334
ashley: Noted in release notes: paused us-west-2 progression due to auth-proxy token retries. Link: https://go/release/2025-06-12#7112223334-notes
kim: Attaching auth-proxy logs & audit snippet to RT-4710. Repro steps for partner-slice-12 added.
oncall-sre: Monitoring remaining regions. Will page SRE on any 5xx >1.5% for 5m.
ravi: grabbing heapdumps and perf maps from canary instances; uploading to RT-4710.
ashley: Thanks. QA: validate key-rollback or config fix. If we confirm key rotation is root cause, we can re-run canary after keys are stabilized; otherwise we'll cut a quick v5.1.1 revert and re-roll in same window.
eng-release-lead: Agreed. Keep notes concise in RT-4710 and we'll reconvene at +25m. For now: staged rollout partially paused (us-west pinned), remaining regions continue watch. :thumbsup:
